svg.title: Demian
svg.desc: Seven single-player games · production acceptance pending. A café-themed 2D game suite with asynchronous weekly competition and a Laravel backend. Mobile, hosting and character-art acceptance remain separate gates. A passing repository CI run is not proof of production backend, live coupons or final sprite acceptance.
